title: Prompt upgrades and more free Notetaker minutes
summary: Your prompts survive a refresh, saved prompts can carry their own sources, and the free Notetaker allowance has doubled.
body_markdown:
A few small October updates.


## Prompts stay when you switch pages


- Leave the page or refresh, and what you’ve typed in the chat box is still there.
- Tag knowledge base entries and precedents in a saved prompt, so the right sources come with it every time you use it.


## More free Notetaker minutes


The free Notetaker allowance has doubled to 120 minutes a month. The Notetaker page shows what’s left and when your minutes reset.
